website_metadata.notes: Woori Bank operates as a foreign-bank branch in India (Chennai/Gurgaon) and reports to RBI; per third-party listings it offers NRE/NRO/FCNR deposits. Its only web presence is the Korean parent global portal (go.wooribank.com, HTTP 200) and the netbanking login (spib.wooribank.com) — neither publishes a public India FD interest-rate page. in.wooribank.com does not resolve (HTTP 000). The only rate listings found are aggregators (codeforbanks), which are banned as a source.

warnings: No bank-owned public FD rate page for India operations; only aggregator listings exist.
